restaurant_name: LABX Clinic สาขาเซ็นทรัลเฟสติวัล พัทยา บีช Central Pattaya Beach FL.4
text:
I’m very disappointed with Lab X. My girlfriend went here for a Brazilian hair removal package. We first paid for six sessions, then added another four when results weren’t showing. That’s 10 treatments in total — and yet, even after all that, she still has about 40% of the hair remaining.

From my research, most reputable clinics state that 4–10 sessions is the typical range needed, depending on the individual. Lab X failed to deliver results even at the high end of that range. To me, this suggests poor equipment, poor technique, or a business model designed to keep selling more sessions without delivering what’s promised.

After nearly a year of treatments, we feel cheated of both our money and time. I would not recommend Lab X in Pattaya for Brazilian hair removal.
